description: The agent must: (1) Read the raw interview transcripts in phase2_interview/raw_notes/ to extract key story materials, colloquial phrases, and business information. (2) Produce persona_profile.json containing: 'tags' array with EXACTLY 3-5 persona keywords, 'topics' array with EXACTLY 15 topic ideas, 'gold_sentences' array with 3-5 key sentences, and a 'core_value' string. (3) Produce shooting_script.md following these proprietary SOP constraints: each gold sentence must appear AT LEAST 3 times throughout the script; the script must follow the 7-stage emotional curve (开场→回忆低谷→转折→奋斗→突破→逆袭→升华价值观); each paragraph block must contain NO MORE THAN 3 sentences; all content lines must be NO MORE THAN 10 Chinese characters (subtitle constraint from phase 6.1 剪内容); the script must use Lin Xiaowei's actual colloquial phrases from the interview (e.g. '身体有它自己的语言，中医是唯一听得懂的') rather than formal written language. A generic agent will fail on: the exact-15-topics requirement, the ≥3 repetitions of gold sentences, the 10-char subtitle line limit, and the ≤3 sentences per paragraph block rule — all of which are non-obvious proprietary constraints defined only in the SKILL.md.
